title: A Place for Everything
story: Incident reports currently live in a folder named final-final-USE-THIS. Bring a tiny amount of order to ByteWorks.
objective: Create the directory /workspace/reports/daily and an empty file named summary.txt inside it.
hints: mkdir creates directories; -p also creates missing parent directories.
touch creates an empty file when it does not already exist.
Try mkdir -p reports/daily, then touch reports/daily/summary.txt
explanation: mkdir -p builds a directory path safely, and touch creates a file (or updates its timestamp in a real shell). Validators inspect the resulting filesystem, so equivalent solutions also count.
